text:
Aisha M: quick heads-up — Strategic Health usage cratered after last week's enablement: daily inference calls down ~88% vs baseline. :warning:
Tom R: doh. any link to the dashboard?
Aisha M: https://rbw.app/dash/strategic-health/usage — last successful spike was 4 days ago, now ~12 calls/day.
Mei L: do we know if the new buyer (VP Ops) got the onboarding deck? I heard procurement is running a proof with Nimbus. :eyes:
Carlos V: confirmed — procurement reached out to Nimbus for a POC last week. they cited faster latency in their tests.
Nora P: CSM note: primary champion (Head of AI) just left; new champion is less technical. I tried to book an enablement call but they pushed to next quarter.
Aisha M: risk lane: low usage + champion change + competitive pilot. Need quick triage: 1) confirm why usage dropped (product/regression/contract) 2) alignment with new buyer 3) offer tailored enablement + quick ROI deck.
Tom R: I can pull usage logs and top failing endpoints. will drop a short query later.
Mei L: ask: can we run a short smoke with quantized model in their region? that would match Nimbus latency numbers.
Carlos V: sales POV — they're mid-enterprise, likely negotiating price/SLAs. we should offer a 30-day performance SLA and a technical co-demo.
Nora P: also capture qualitative feedback: why champions deprioritized. I'll schedule a 30-min call with the new VP Ops for Monday.
insights-bot: Summary metric alert — Strategic Health: daily_calls change = -88% (7d), avg_latency change = +2% (no major regressions).
Aisha M: thanks Tom + Nora. Mei: can you draft a 10-min demo script focused on latency and integration friction? Carlos: prepare a competitive one-pager comparing feature parity + economics vs Nimbus.
Mei L: will do. adding a short checklist: a) quick KV cache check b) tokenization differences c) region routing config.
Tom R: query posted in #eng-ops with logs snippet:
```
SELECT date, calls FROM usage WHERE customer_id='sh-001' AND date > NOW() - INTERVAL '14 days';
-- last 7 days: [2025-03-10: 14, 03-11: 12, 03-12: 11, 03-13: 13, 03-14: 10, 03-15: 9, 03-16: 8]
```
Aisha M: good. if logs show client-side throttling we can fix without discount. if it's product regression, escalate to eng.
Carlos V: I'll loop in legal for a trial SLA if needed.
Nora P: scheduling note: added Monday 0900 PT slot, invites sent to VP Ops and interim Head of AI.
Mei L: prep task: bring a short synthetic test the customer can run in 15 min to demonstrate latency and throughput.
Aisha M: OK team — owners: Tom (root cause logs), Mei (demo script + synthetic), Carlos (commercial + one-pager), Nora (stakeholder alignment + call). I'll own the follow-up and renewal risk score. Update here after the Monday call. :handshake:
Carlos V: +1, we should also capture what Nimbus promised — can someone surface their trial terms?
Tom R: I'll scrape the competitive notes and post in this thread.
insights-bot: Risk model preliminary score: "elevated" (0.67).
Aisha M: thanks — leaning toward short-term enablement + SLA offer rather than discount right now. we'll reconvene after call. :thumbsup:
